UNEMPLOYMENT INSURANCE WEEKLY CLAIMS REPORT

SEASONALLY ADJUSTED DATA

In the week ending July 17, the advance figure for seasonally adjusted initial claims was 464,000.

The advance number for seasonally adjusted insured unemployment during the week ending July 10 was 4,487,000.
